errors.evidence: The x-axis is a categorical axis with specific numerical labels (64, 128, 256, 512, 768); it is not a linear scale where the distance between points is proportional to the difference in their values.
The intervals between the values on the x-axis are not constant. The differences are 64 (128-64), 128 (256-128), 256 (512-256), and 256 (768-512).

errors.evidence: The range of the data values is from 0.746 to a peak value slightly above 0.755. Stating the range ends at 0.754 is incorrect as the maximum value on the plot is higher than 0.754.
When the matrix dimension is 64, the F1 value is exactly 0.746, as indicated by the y-axis tick mark, not 0.747.
When the matrix dimension is 256, the F1 value is exactly 0.754, as indicated by the corresponding grid line, not 0.752.
When the matrix dimension is 512, the F1 value is at its peak, which is visibly above the 0.754 grid line (approximately 0.7555), not 0.753.
The description does not mention that the data points on the line are indicated by circular markers.
